learning_outcomes.text: Students further develop their ability to recognize which questions in engineering sciences can be answered with the help of mathematics, and can formulate such questions themselves.
understand logical argumentation, recognize conditions, consequences, and rules, and can build a chain of arguments in the context of engineering applications.
recognize known types of problems in known and new contexts, and can solve these problems with known methods.
are able to understand the mathematical language used in engineering literature and to describe their own arguments and solution approaches verbally and in writing.
can confidently handle the presented mathematical methods.

syllabus_topics: Power series: Fundamentals, Taylor series, Applications
Linear mappings: Fundamentals, Eigenvalues and eigenvectors, Applications
Differential calculus in R^n: Fundamentals, Differentiation rules, Applications
Integral calculus in R^n: Fundamentals, Integration methods, Applications
assessment_rules: The bonus point system according to the examination regulations of TH Ingolstadt may be optionally used by the instructors of this module. The decision will be announced at the beginning of the course.
